reasoning_input.question_text: Find the Cartesian equation of the locus given by arg((z - 2)/(z + 2)) = π/4.

student_steps.content: Let z = x + iy: arg((x - 2) + iy) - arg((x + 2) + iy) = π/4

reasoning_input.final_answer: Arc of circle x² + (y - 2)² = 8 above the real axis (y > 0)

steps.description: Apply argument subtraction property arg(A/B) = arg(A) - arg(B)
Substitute z = x + iy and express arguments as arctan
Apply tangent addition formula tan(A-B) = (tan A - tan B)/(1 + tan A tan B) = 1
Form complete circle equation x² + (y - 2)² = 8 and state arc domain restriction y > 0
